title: nixos/mediawiki: allow adding programs for extended functionality via `cfg.path`
reason: Applicable: real mediawiki module + wired test. Real diff wires the ALREADY-DECLARED `path` option (unchanged by this diff) into a genuinely new toolsPath derivation used in a package-build substituteInPlace step -- not a new declaration, but a real new USE of an existing option.
targets_toml: single target mediawiki, cfg_ident=cfg, option_prefix=[services,mediawiki], watch=[path].

additional_raw_facts_for_reviewer.note: 20th candidate_rendering_gap instance -- interesting that path itself was OptionNotFound at BASE despite being pre-existing/unchanged; did not have time to determine why an unchanged option shows not-found at base too (possibly path is declared in a part of the file not otherwise examined, or the option_prefix needs adjustment) -- noting honestly rather than asserting a cause.
